lines.text: The doors are pushed shut and the latch engages. Security has the report: found ajar during an escorted check, cause unknown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Request recorded: Facilities to check the lobby door latch and the corridor ventilation pressure. The doors were found ajar after an unwatched interval; no cause is assumed.

lines.speaker: staff_hale
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: staff_hale
lines.text: The pass was for one inspection. Any follow-up gets its own request.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hale reads your note and signs the pass back in.

lines.speaker: staff_hale
lines.text: Closed, then ajar, nobody watching in between. That's what goes in the log.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ward entry doors are controlled access again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two archived export representations of the same access event disagree about its date. The time-zone provenance of each is still being reconciled. Neither version is shown to be the original.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mara Ellis also raised a date question about her records. Where does this belong?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing new at the worksheet yet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her note documents her care. An export date conflict is not a clinical finding and does not belong in her record. Her note stays as written and confidential.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A disagreement between two system exports is not a psychiatric symptom. Nothing about it is hers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Records technician: Then we preserve the original versions as they were received.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Recorded in the incident record: two export representations disagree on the access-event date; time-zone provenance unreconciled. Mara's clinical note is unchanged and kept separate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text:
Incident record
Two export versions; dates disagree; time-zone provenance unreconciled; originals as received.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: How should it be handled?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Decide where the date conflict belongs first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Incident record: two export versions disagree on the date; handling recorded; originals unchanged.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Records technician: We don't edit originals. A corrected copy would be a third version, not an answer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing is changed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Escalation requested through the audit process. Both versions stay as received; no date is chosen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Both versions are preserved separately with their provenance. Neither is treated as corroborating the other.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Independent technical review requested. Until it reports, the date stays unresolved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The analyst's note is attached to the worksheet.

lines.speaker: analyst
lines.text: I can show you where the clocks differ. I can't reconstruct this interval responsibly from these records alone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Part of the mismatch is accounted for by clock differences between systems. The rest of the reported interval is not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The analyst only accounts for part of it. Writing the rest off as skew claims more than the records show.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Unreconciled is not missing. The records don't establish that any time was lost; they establish that they can't be reconciled yet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Report recorded: part of the timing mismatch is explained by clock differences; the remainder of the reported interval cannot be reconstructed from the available records. Source, preservation and audit requests remain open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bennett is pulling on her coat.

lines.speaker: staff_bennett
lines.text: Any luck?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bennett is busy.

lines.speaker: staff_bennett
lines.text: Did you? Or did you find records that don't agree?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You haven't found anything that was lost. Tell her what you actually have.

lines.speaker: staff_bennett
lines.text: Then you're doing what you're supposed to. Don't decide the answer first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She heads for the staff entrance.
